messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered: SEV2 - billing-metering token-count drift. Multiple overage flags firing for customer accounts. Pager link: https://pagerduty.redwood/INC-2149. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/billing-token-drift

sam: taking this, im oncall for billing right now

jen: ack, joining. any customer-visible impact yet?

sam: seeing a spike in emitted tokens 03:00-03:08 UTC, approx 2x baseline for that window. Overflags triggered for a handful of mid-market customers, some invoice jobs flagged. Quick query from shadow emitter: 
```sql
select minute, emitted_tokens from emitter_metrics where minute >= '2026-03-21T03:00:00Z' order by minute;
03:00  1,200,000
03:01  1,350,000
03:02  1,400,000
baseline ~700k/min
```

oli: checking ingestion consumers and kafka lag, pulling deploy history for billing-ingest

billing-bot: shadow-ledger compare shows ledger_count / source_count = 1.95 for window 03:00-03:10. Duplicate signature rate up.

jen: did anything deploy around 02:55-03:00?

oli: found a canary rolled at 02:58 which changed dedupe heuristics (pr 482). tagging the deploy id. Investigating revert feasibility now

sam: propose mitigation plan: 1) suppress overage alerts to customers (temporary) 2) rollback canary for billing-ingest 3) start dedupe backfill and queue credits if duplicates confirmed. Any objections?

nina: +1 to suppression while we confirm, i can coordinate comms once we have affected list

jen: go for suppression, but document in incident channel so CS knows why alerts suppressed

sam: executing rollback now: 
```bash
kubectl -n billing rollout undo deployment/billing-ingest --to-revision=12  # revert to rev 12 (pre-canary)
```

oli: rollback initiated, watching pods. also pausing emitter producers on low priority region to reduce inflight duplicates

sam: rollback complete, new pods ready. running quick sanity query

billing-bot: post-rollback shadow compare: 03:06-03:12 window shows ratio back to 1.03, duplicate signature rate dropping

sam: starting dedupe backfill job with dry-run first. command: 
```bash
jobs/run_dedupe_backfill --window "2026-03-21T03:00:00Z/2026-03-21T03:15:00Z" --dry-run
```

jen: can we get list of affected customers for comms and potential credits?

billing-bot: generating affected_accounts list now, will post when ready. Preliminary count: ~12 customers saw overflag threshold, mostly mid-market tenants in eu-west1 and us-east1

nina: drafting a short customer notice: "We observed inflated usage signals for a short period due to an internal deploy. We reverted the change and are issuing credits for duplicated tokens. No action required from customers." Will share draft in #customer-notices

sam: mitigation summary: rollback applied, suppression active, dedupe backfill running dry-run then exec. Monitoring for normalization. Current severity: reduced to SEV3.

oli: monitoring dashboards show token rates converging to baseline over next 4 minutes, kafka consumer lag normal.

billing-bot: backfill dry-run indicates ~98% of excess counts are exact duplicates and eligible for automatic crediting. Scheduling actual backfill in 10m

jen: ok - I'll hold off on public notice until backfill completes, but CS standby for proactive outreach if any customer pings.

sam: assigning postmortem owners: sam, oli, and billing team. action items: revert validation tests for dedupe logic to include integration test, add metrics alert for signature drift, and improve canary gating.

nina: noted, will create follow-up ticket and schedule customer comms with legal if needed

incidents-bot: incident timeline recorded. Please add any additional notes to the incident doc: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2149

sam: status update: stable, continuing to monitor for 30m, moving to mitigation phase. closing in 30 unless we see regressions :thumbsup:

jen: thanks team. good response.
